mode.on.full.message: Text-only mode on. Only the chat is left. Type {0} to go back.
mode.on.full.description: Chat message when the mode turns on. {0} = the short command, e.g. /trpg.

mode.on.worldOnly.message: 3D world off. The HUD and frame rate are unchanged. Type {0} to go back.
mode.on.worldOnly.description: Chat message when the mode turns on with the '3D world off only' setting. {0} = the short command.

mode.off.description: Chat message when the mode turns off.

mode.notLoggedIn.message: Text-only mode needs a logged-in character.
mode.notLoggedIn.description: Error shown when the mode is requested without a logged-in character.

mode.alreadyOn.message: Text-only mode is already on. Type {0} off to go back.
mode.alreadyOn.description: Shown when the mode is turned on while already on. {0} = the short command.

mode.alreadyOff.description: Shown when the mode is turned off while already off.

command.help.main.message: Turn text-only mode on or off (only the chat stays, low CPU). {0} help for more.
command.help.main.description: Help text of the main command in Dalamud's command list. {0} = the main command, /textmode.

command.help.alias.description: Help text of the short command. {0} = the main command.

command.unknown.description: Chat error for a command option that doesn't exist. {0} = what the player typed.

command.usage.toggle.message: {0} — turn text-only mode on or off

command.usage.onOff.message: {0} on | off — turn it on / off
command.usage.onOff.description: Usage line. 'on' and 'off' are the words the player types and must stay as they are. {0} = the short command.

command.usage.status.message: {0} status — show the mode, frame rate cap and CPU use
command.usage.status.description: Usage line. 'status' is typed by the player and must stay. {0} = the short command.

command.usage.settings.description: Usage line. 'settings' is typed by the player and must stay. {0} = the short command.

command.usage.help.message: {0} help — show this list ({1} works too)
command.usage.help.description: Usage line. 'help' is typed by the player and must stay. {0} = the short command, {1} = the main command.

dtr.text.description: Short text of the entry in the server info bar.

dtr.tooltip.message:
Text-Only Mode: click to hide everything but the chat and save CPU.
Type {0} to come back.
dtr.tooltip.description: Tooltip of the server info bar entry. {0} = the short command.

status.line.description: The /trpg status line. {0} = on/off, {1} = the 3D part, {2} = the frame rate part, {3} = number of hidden UI elements, {4} = CPU and FPS text.

status.on.description: Mode state in the status line.

status.off.description: Mode state in the status line.

status.3dWaiting.description: Appended to the 3D part while a change waits for a loading screen; keep the leading space.

status.fpsCap.description: Frame rate part of the status line. {0} = frames per second.

status.noFpsCap.description: Frame rate part of the status line when there is no cap.

cpu.describe.description: CPU and FPS text. {0} = current CPU %, {1} = average CPU %, {2} = frames per second.

cpu.compare.description: Measured CPU use in normal play and in text-only mode. {0} and {1} are percentages with one decimal; keep the number formats.

cpu.compare.less.description: Adds how much lower text-only mode was. {0} = the text above, {1} = percent.

cpu.compare.more.description: Adds how much higher text-only mode was. {0} = the text above, {1} = percent.

settings.intro.message: Or type {0}. In the mode only the chat window stays, the 3D world and the rest of the HUD are hidden, and the frame rate is capped.
settings.intro.description: Settings window text. {0} = the short command.

settings.worldOnly.message: 3D world off only (HUD and frame rate unchanged)

settings.worldOnly.help.message: Unchecked (default) is full text-only mode. A change applies the next time you turn the mode on.

settings.fps.help.message: Lower frame rates save more CPU. Typing uses the higher one (and for 3 s after).

settings.dtr.message: Show TRPG in the server info bar

settings.afk.message: Turn on when I go AFK

settings.afk.help.message: When the game marks you AFK, the mode turns on, and off again when you're back. If it was already on, it stays on.
settings.afk.help.description: Help text under the AFK checkbox.

settings.saving.none.message: Use the mode for a few seconds to see how much CPU it saves.
settings.saving.none.description: Shown until the plugin has measured both normal play and the mode.

settings.tests.running.description: Button label while the tests run.

settings.tests.help.message: Checks the mode works on your game and measures how much CPU and GPU it saves; the results appear in chat. Takes about 1½ minutes.{0}
settings.tests.help.description: Help text under the test button. {0} = the note below (selftest.note).

selftest.note.message: Keep the game window focused and don't type or move until they finish; the screen will go blank a few times.
selftest.note.description: Appended to the test start message and help; keep the leading space.

selftest.skipped.message: Text-only mode is on, so the tests that need normal play (and the savings measurements) are skipped. For the full run, type {0} off first.
selftest.skipped.description: Chat message. {0} = the short command. 'off' is typed by the player and must stay.

selftest.alreadyRunning.message: Text-Only Mode self-tests are already running.

selftest.summary.description: Chat message. {0} = the result summary, e.g. '12 passed'.

selftest.savings.message: Measured savings (the game's own CPU and GPU use):
selftest.savings.description: Chat heading above the savings table.
